name: the opt-in gate never stops the script
why: Brucebase support is opt-in (sa_enable_brucebase, default off). Without the gate the script would put its toolbar on the wiki's page with the setting off; the spec must see the heading and toolbar appear.

name: no <h1> is injected; the wiki's own header <h1> holds the toolbar
why: The generic header lookup falls back to document.querySelector('h1'), the wiki's site name in #header. The spec pins the toolbar on h1.mb-bb-h1 and none in #header.

name: the Alt. repeats are not de-duplicated
why: The Alt. tab lists the 10 subtitle songs a second time; without the de-duplication they become 10 extra rows lettered Alt. The spec pins one row per distinct song and no Alt. letter.
grep: every song of the letter tabs|Alt. repeat keeps its own

name: Letter is not written
why: The Letter cell comes from the tab label; leaving it empty breaks the Letter filter and the per-row letters the spec pins.
grep: Alt. repeat keeps its own|a Letter column filter

name: the tab label's =- -= markers are kept
why: Without the label parser every Letter reads '=- A -=' rather than 'A'.

name: the letter tabview is left on the page
why: The tabs would stay below the table, every song shown twice. The spec pins exactly one yui-navset (the second one) after the press.
grep: every song of the letter tabs

name: no <h2> before the table
why: updateH2Count() anchors the row count and filter bar to the last h2 before the table; the spec pins the injected h2 in front of it.
grep: every song of the letter tabs

name: the shared table CSS does not name Brucebase
why: _ensureForeignTableStyle() is keyed on the hosts' body classes; without .mb-sa-host-bb the table renders unstyled. The spec pins the border and padding.
grep: every song of the letter tabs

name: Load from Disk does not convert the reloaded page
why: After a reload the live page holds the letter tabs again; without this call site the restored rows render while the tabview stays beside them. The spec pins one yui-navset after the load.

name: the click-time conversion is skipped
why: Without the pre-processing call there is no table.tbl for the pipeline to read, and the button renders nothing.
grep: every song of the letter tabs

name: _foreignHost does not name Brucebase
why: The detection loop only considers definitions whose host equals _foreignHost; without the Brucebase arm it is null there, the bb-songs definition is never considered, and no toolbar appears. (Removing the host comparison itself is a guard no spec can see; jl-support.json records that one.)

name: the song list is also read from the rest of the document
why: A guard no spec can see on this page: reading every /song: link of the document after the letter tabs would add the second tabview's 'Released (Not on Springsteen Album)' songs, but all 41 of them are also in the letter tabs (checked on the 2026-10-07 snapshot), and the letter tabview comes first, so first-wins de-duplication drops them again and no row or letter changes. Kept because the site can list a song there before it lists it under its letter.
grep: every song of the letter tabs|Alt. repeat keeps its own

name: the status line sits below the theme's h1 rule again
why: Reported 2026-10-09: the flannel-ocean theme underlines every h1 and pulls #breadcrumbs up by 0.5em; with the rule left on the toolbar h1 the status line sits under it and the breadcrumbs run into it.
